cards.headline: Camp Lo, heroes the Avalanches once sampled
cards.snippet: For "Because I'm Me," on the Australian group the Avalanches' 2016 album Wildflower, the band worked with Camp Lo. They were thrilled by it. They had often played Camp Lo's Uptown Saturday Night at their shows. They had also sampled it on their 2000 debut, Since I Left You. Wildflower was their first album in 16 years.
cards.context: Wildflower, 2016, was the Avalanches' first album in 16 years.

cards.headline: A 16-year album built like a mixtape
cards.snippet: The Avalanches' 2016 album Wildflower, which includes "Because I'm Me," was produced over 16 years. After their 2000 debut, the Australian group got caught up in other work. Robbie Chater was ill for three years. A King Kong theater score and an animated film that lost its funding also took up their time. Finished in March 2016, the album was pieced together like a mixtape from tracks that fit one style. Leftovers from the abandoned projects ended up on it.
cards.context: Because I'm Me is one of 21 tracks on the album.

cards.headline: The boy never existed, says this reading
cards.snippet:
The boy does not exist.
The man on the BENCH was the one hitting on the ticket lady! The boy was the beautiful, loveable , childish and talented person the "subway bum" imagined himself to be.

cards.headline: Where the budget went
cards.snippet: When all you have is a dime because you spent all your money on back up dancers, feats, and a blow up heart.
